reason: I have one, maybe two chairs and I am cutting hair myself the whole day, so I already know who is in which chair and what is in the drawer. My register has worked for years and UPI shows me the rest; I don't need ₹999 every month for something I can see with my own eyes.
objection: This is made for a big salon with many staff. For me it is ₹5,000 plus ₹12,000 a year, and the selfie check-in will make my one helper feel I don't trust him.
would_change_my_mind: If it was only the WhatsApp bill and 'customer due back' reminder for maybe ₹199 a month with no setup fee, and a barber friend showed me it actually brought customers back.
